mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1050.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 440000.0) indicate strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) signals manufacturing expansion that increases corporate output and profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.0%) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% reflects aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS < 140000.0) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 140000.0 and UNRATE > 5.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1050.0 (HOUST > 1050.0) during housing market expansions signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
